::: {.callout-warning}
## 2027 presenter guidance is forthcoming

Presentation formats, timing, poster dimensions, and day-of instructions have
not yet been confirmed. The information below is carried forward from the 2027
symposium as a planning reference.
:::

## Who can present?

For the 2027 symposium, oral and poster presentations were open to graduate
students and postdoctoral researchers. Faculty and other researchers were
encouraged to attend and participate in the discussion.

To submit work for the next meeting, see [Abstracts](abstracts.qmd).

## Presentation opportunities

SoCal BOOM is designed to foreground early-career research. In 2027, graduate
students and postdoctoral researchers could request one of three formats:

- a full-length oral presentation;
- a lightning talk; or
- a poster presentation.

## Oral presentations

### Full-length talks

The 2027 program assigned each speaker a 15-minute slot: 12 minutes for the
presentation and 3 minutes for questions. Speakers were asked to bring their
presentation on a flash drive or send it to an organizer before the meeting.

### Lightning talks

Lightning speakers received a 5-minute presentation slot. Questions were held
until the end of the session so the audience could discuss the lightning talks
together.

## Poster presentations

The maximum poster size in 2027 was 45 × 45 inches. Both 45 × 45-inch square
posters and 45 × 36-inch horizontal posters fit the supplied double-sided
boards. Clips and push pins were provided.

Two poster sessions were held during the meeting. Presenters checked in at the
registration table to receive a board location and were expected to attend
their poster only during their assigned session.

## Before the meeting

Once the current program is released, check the [Schedule](schedule.qmd) for
your assigned talk time or poster session. Questions can be sent through
[Contact Us](../contact.qmd).

*[Source: 2027 information for presenters](https://socalboom.wordpress.com/home/information-for-presenters/).*
